description: This Java class implements a no-operation (noop) version of the SamplingService interface, providing methods for sampling and resetting, but without performing any actual sampling logic. It simply executes provided Runnable or Supplier functions and returns empty SamplingData.

classes.name: NoopSamplingService
classes.description: A no-op implementation of the SamplingService interface that executes given sampling functions without performing any real sampling.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Executes the provided Runnable sample without additional logic.

methods.name: <T> T sample
methods.description: Executes the provided Supplier and returns its result.

methods.name: getSamplingData
methods.description: Returns a new SamplingData instance initialized with an empty map.
